versions.name: Massawepie Scout Camps - Adirondack Treks
versions.address: 65 Massawepie Rd Tupper Lake, New York 12986

features.note: Hiking treks range from pond-hopping itineraries to peak-bagging routes.
Crews clean up and shower on returning to base camp.
Canoe routes run from short trips to over seventy miles; crews pass a swimmer test and a canoe test before departing.
Base camp health services cover trek crews, including a medical re-check on arrival.

A dedicated Adirondack trek program: crews of up to seven, aged fourteen and over, on three- to six-day canoe, hiking or combination routes, each led by a trained staff Voyageur guide certified for wilderness travel.
Open only to participants aged fourteen and over, or thirteen with the eighth grade completed.
Crews cook their own trail meals using camp-issued stove and frybake kits.
